mapper.select: SELECT attribute.id, attribute.object_candidate_id AS objectCandidateId, object.name AS objectName, attribute.name, attribute.code, attribute.type_category AS typeCategory, attribute.basic_type_code AS basicTypeCode, attribute.business_type_id AS businessTypeId, attribute.business_type_source AS businessTypeSource, attribute.unit, attribute.decimal_places AS decimalPlaces, attribute.format, attribute.enum_type AS enumType, attribute.enum_source AS enumSource FROM om_ai_attribute attribute INNER JOIN om_ai_object object ON object.id = attribute.object_candidate_id AND object.del_flag = 0 WHERE attribute.task_id = #{taskId} AND attribute.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY attribute.id LIMIT 1000

SELECT id, object_candidate_id, name, type_category, basic_type_code, business_type_id, business_type_source, unit, decimal_places, format, enum_type, enum_source FROM om_ai_attribute WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND id = #{attributeCandidateId} AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
